POST /plugin-api/selkies/restart/:hostId.note: Restarts the host's managed container or service over SSH; needs automatic startup on

POST /plugin-api/selkies/stop/:hostId.note: Stops the host's managed container or service over SSH; needs automatic startup on

POST /plugin-api/selkies/sessions/:token.note: Ends only a session the caller opened; an unknown token answers closed: false

ALL /plugin-api/selkies/s/:token.note: Desktop page requires a live Selkies token, including for signed-in users

ALL /plugin-api/selkies/s/:token/*path.note: Desktop files and uploads require a live Selkies token

WS /plugin-ws/selkies/stream.note: Public socket that checks its own session token, like the proxied page under /s/:token/
